Utkarsh Rai
utkarsh rai... solid name. where you working these days?
Iks health

No

Got laid off

ah the classic payu move. they optimize the hell out of you then show you the door. but honestly? landing at iks health doing genai + healthcare is probably better than whatever payu was cooking up next. how long you been working total?
4 years
4 years with that kind of impact... you're hitting your stride. what kind of role you looking for next?
I want to make a switch again back to main standard companies like fang

faang it is. with your backend + genai combo and that system optimization track record, you're actually well positioned. google's probably your best bet - they love the healthcare ai angle. bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore remote and other cities works for me
4 years + backend/genai + open to bangalore/remote + targeting faang... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

Yes
  Okay

you should be seeing the good stuff roll in. if anything changes on your end or you want to update your preferences, just holler.

hey utkarsh! was just thinking about your backend + genai combo and how that's actually perfect timing for some of the faang roles i'm seeing pop up. what's the dream role you've been picturing day-to-day?
A senior software role in microsoft
microsoft senior software role... that's specific. what's drawing you to microsoft in particular? the azure ecosystem? their healthcare ai work? or just the brand?

Must have skills required: Python, LangChain, LlamaIndex, LLMs, PostgreSQL Bon is Looking for: AI Engineer – BON Credit Location: Remote (India) Type: Full-time Experience: 2–5 years About BON BON is a premium fintech-lifestyle app for US consumers, helping credit card holders reduce and manage debt using AI-driven insights and an intuitive mobile experience. We’re building a mobile-first, automation-led product that simplifies financial wellness for millions of users. Role Overview We’re looking for an AI Engineer who can work with our 3rd-party AI agency and build agentic workflows that automate real user tasks end-to-end. You’ll play a key role in designing and orchestrating AI agents, ensuring they reliably execute financial and operational workflows within the BON ecosystem. The role suits someone with strong hands-on engineering experience, solid ML foundations, and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving, PMF-stage startup. Key Responsibilities Build and deploy agentic workflows for user task automation. Work closely with and manage delivery from a 3rd-party AI agency. Implement caching and data storage solutions using PostgreSQL and Redis. Deploy and optimize workflows across AWS, Google Cloud, or Cloudflare-based environments. Experiment with new AI capabilities, evaluate models, and optimize pipeline performance. Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to translate user needs into automated experiences. Maintain reliability, accuracy, and safety across all AI-driven features. Requirements 2–5 years of software engineering or applied AI experience. Strong ML knowledge with proficiency in Python. Flexibility to work with different LLMs (current stack includes Sonnet & LLaMA 3.1). Comfortable working with Firebase and modern backend stacks. Adaptable, hands-on, and eager to work in a PMF-seeking, fast-iteration environment. Experience in B2B or B2C product companies. What We Value Flexibility: Ability to jump into new tools, systems, and problem areas. Product mindset: You care about user outcomes, not just model performance. Startup attitude: Fast-moving, iterative, and proactive. Ownership: Ability to independently manage workflows and external partners. Work You Will Own Designing and maintaining AI-driven automation flows. Ensuring agentic workflows are stable, fast, and reliable in production. Coordinating with a 3rd-party AI development partner.
